settings.title: Own version first
settings.label: Write my own version first
settings.body: A smooth answer that arrives too soon can paper over what you were unsure of, and afterwards it is hard to tell what you really learned. With this on, Solve and chat ask for three short lines before you send: what you understand now, what you are least sure of, and what would show you have learned it. After an answer you can close it and retell it in your own words, without looking.

retell.hidden: The answer is hidden while you retell it.
retell.label: Your retell, without looking
retell.hint: Explain, work or decide it again in your own words. If you cannot go on without the answer, it is still a scaffold, not yet your own.
